purpose: Define required metadata and production constraints for one mosaic-derived dungeon-map tile asset.

field_contract.asset_id: Stable lowercase id for the tile asset.
field_contract.source_image_path: Local path to the verified source reference image or placeholder until human verification.
field_contract.source_title: Exact source title from institution record; use pending placeholder until verified.
field_contract.source_author_or_culture: Exact author, maker, or culture from source record; use pending placeholder until verified.
field_contract.source_date_or_period: Exact date or period from source record; use pending placeholder until verified.
field_contract.source_license: Explicit source license or public-domain status; must not be empty.
field_contract.palette_id: Stable id for the palette used.
field_contract.allowed_palette: Array of hex RGB colors allowed for the tile.
field_contract.required_layers: Must include every layer in required_layers.
field_contract.animation_tags_or_export_tags: Must include every tag in required_export_tags.
field_contract.seamless_required: Boolean indicating whether edge continuity review is required.
field_contract.border_padding_px: Integer padding reserved for borders or edge treatment.
field_contract.export_targets: Array of export target objects, usually PNG and JSON metadata.
field_contract.notes: Operator notes, source caveats, or review comments.
